title: Aging Intervention Observations Schema
description: Schema and validation rules for senolytics and partial reprogramming observations extracted from PubMed and bioRxiv abstracts.

record_id.description: Linked source identifier from raw papers dataset (PMID:... or DOI:10....).

source.description: Source database where the paper was collected.

is_preprint.description: Whether the record is a preprint (true for bioRxiv, false for PubMed).

intervention_name.description: Compound or reprogramming factor name (e.g., Dasatinib+Quercetin, OSKM, OSK, or 'unknown').

tissue_or_organ.description: Target tissue or organ in lowercase snake_case (e.g., lung, brain, kidney, skin, liver, systemic) or 'not_specified'.

cell_type.description: Target cell type in lowercase snake_case (e.g., fibroblast, chondrocyte, microglia, endothelial_cell) or 'not_specified'.

aspect_category.description: Primary evaluation aspect represented by this row.

marker_or_endpoint.description: Measured aging marker or safety/oncogenesis endpoint (e.g., CDKN2A/p16, SA-beta-gal, SASP, tumor_formation).

direction.description: Observed direction of change or presence/absence.

safety_flag.description: Summary flag for toxicity or oncogenesis signals.

evidence_quote.description: Supporting excerpt or sentence from the abstract.

curation_status.description: Verification status of the observation row.

csv_notes: When reading observations.csv in Python, keep_default_na=False is recommended so 'unknown' or 'not_specified' strings are not silently turned into NaN.
Boolean fields like is_preprint in CSV should be normalized to 'true' or 'false' (or parsed cleanly as bool).
Duplicate obs_id values or missing evidence_quote values should fail validation.
